in_sanskrit.name: Labanya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Gratitude
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Labanya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Labanya is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Labh' meaning 'to obtain'. The name Labanya signifies the goddess of gratitude and prosperity. It is believed that this name bestows blessings of abundance and contentment upon the bearer. In Hindu mythology, Labanya is the goddess of wealth and abundance. She is often depicted holding a lotus or a bowl of rice, symbolizing prosperity and nourishment.
